coordinate_frame: Original output/sw-probe/arm.glb global frame, right handed, +Y up. Same orientation and origin as SW arm assembly; web GLB preserves it.
mapping_source: Complete arm_tagged subtree, old rigid-link map as mounting hints, and engineer_tagged J1 drive bounding region; no source mesh exclusions within the arm.
motor_policy: Complete source motor assemblies; rigid translation with the owning link, no internal separation.
belt_policy: CAD tooth segments joined into one belt part per link and belt specification.
explosion_policy: Two stages: radial CAD group separation about the complete arm volume-weighted geometric center, then small mounting-axis part offsets. Close in reverse stage order. Complete motors and mounting bundles remain rigid.

quality_policy.protected: Structural parts, motors, bearings, chains, gears and pulleys retain cleaned source tessellation. Screw/nut thread detail is limited to 600 triangles per source object.
quality_policy.normals: 35 degree smoothing; area-weighted planar normals except motors.
quality_policy.merge: Same material within rigid mounting bundles only.

coverage.volume_method: Absolute signed triangle-mesh volume per source primitive; open or inconsistent shells are not physical mass/volume proof.
